row.team_price_text: Performance: starting at $15/month (5 active users), additional users $15/month
row.evidence: "SAML single sign-on for CircleCI is available for Scale Plan customers", and even with SSO enforced "New organization members must be invited to your organization"; CircleCI's docs and API reference document no SCIM endpoint.
row.notes: Status changed from unknown (June) to none. The September check found an explicit answer in CircleCI's own docs: SAML SSO (Scale only) authenticates existing members, but every user must already have a CircleCI email/password or social login and new members must be invited by hand. Neither the full docs index (llms.txt) nor the API v2 OpenAPI mentions SCIM, and Okta's CircleCI catalogue app is SWA only. Okta SAML group mapping can sync group membership at sign-in. Pricing is credit-based: Performance starts at $15/month with 5 active users and $15/month (25,000 credits) per extra user; Scale is custom and billed annually. The June note's ~$2,000/mo Scale figure has no first-party source and was dropped. Under the post-pilot rules the SWA-only Okta app maps to idp.okta none, and scim.available is null rather than false because no CircleCI page says SCIM is not offered. Help-centre search for 'scim' (support.circleci.com) returns no articles.

plans.name: Performance
plans.price_text: Starting at $15/month, 5 active users included, additional users $15/month

limitations.text: With SSO enforced, new organization members must still be invited manually; SSO does not create accounts.
SSO requires every user to already have a CircleCI email/password or social (GitHub/Bitbucket) login before the SSO login; one SSO domain per organization.
When a user's SSO session expires they lose access to the organization's resources until they re-authenticate (access control, not deprovisioning).

endpoints.purpose: Information about the user with the given ID
Delete a group, its memberships and its role grants (standalone organizations only)

limitations.text: API v2 has no documented endpoints to invite, add, remove or change the role of organization members; group endpoints create and delete groups but do not manage membership.
Group create/get/delete is only supported for standalone (circleci-type) organizations.
Audit logs are requested in the web app and downloaded as CSV; continuous streaming to an AWS S3 bucket needs the Scale plan. No audit-log REST endpoint is documented.

okta.notes: Only SWA (password vaulting) is checked in the OIN page markup; no SAML, OIDC or SCIM.

fallbacks.other_sync: SSO group mapping with Okta: SAML 'groups' attribute maps IdP groups to CircleCI groups, updated when users sign in via SSO (Scale)

open_questions: No CircleCI page says in so many words that SCIM is not offered; 'none' rests on the SSO docs (manual invites, pre-existing CircleCI login required) and on SCIM appearing nowhere in the docs index or the API v2 OpenAPI.
Whether CircleCI offers SCIM or provisioning on custom Scale contracts or CircleCI Server is not public.
Removing a member: docs checked do not say whether removing a user from the IdP or the org frees the active-user charge (billing is per active committing user).
Entra gallery (Learn tutorial URL 404), Google Workspace, OneLogin and JumpCloud (Access Denied) catalogue listings were not verified.
API v2 rate limits for the user and group endpoints are not documented (only a generic 429 response).
CSV import of users is not documented in the pages checked.
